profile.hoursNote: Also closed on New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, and Christmas. Callback requests sent outside office hours are returned the next business day.
profile.serviceAreaNote: Springfield (fictional) and nearby towns. Coverage is confirmed by 5-digit ZIP code.

faqs.question: Do you work on homes and businesses?
faqs.answer: Cedar Hollow works on homes only. It doesn’t take commercial or business properties.

faqs.question: How much does a repair visit cost?
faqs.answer: Repair visits have an $89 diagnostic fee (sample demo price). The technician explains the repair price before any work starts, and the fee is applied to the repair if you approve it the same day.

faqs.question: Do you offer free estimates?
faqs.answer: Estimates for replacing a heating or cooling system are free. Repair visits have the $89 diagnostic fee (sample demo price).

faqs.question: Can you give me an exact price over chat?
faqs.answer: No. Apart from the diagnostic fee and the Comfort Club plan, prices depend on the equipment and the job, so the office gives prices after a technician has looked at it.

faqs.question: Do you offer discounts or coupons?
faqs.answer: Comfort Club members get 10% off repairs. No other discounts or coupons are currently offered.

faqs.question: Do you offer maintenance plans?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Comfort Club plan is $159 per year (sample demo price) and includes a spring cooling tune-up and a fall heating tune-up, plus 10% off repairs.

faqs.question: Do you offer financing?
faqs.answer: Financing is available for new system installations, subject to credit approval. The office can share the details on a callback.

faqs.question: What warranty do you offer?
faqs.answer: New installations include a 1-year labor warranty from Cedar Hollow in addition to the manufacturer’s equipment warranty. Repairs include a 90-day labor warranty.

faqs.question: Do you work on all brands?
faqs.answer: Cedar Hollow services most major brands of furnaces, air conditioners, heat pumps, and mini-splits. The office can confirm for a specific older or unusual model.

faqs.question: Are your technicians licensed and insured?
faqs.answer: Yes. All Cedar Hollow technicians are licensed and insured.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: Cedar Hollow accepts cash, checks, and major credit cards, paid when the work is done. The chat never asks for payment details.

faqs.question: Do you offer after-hours emergency service?
faqs.answer: No. Cedar Hollow doesn’t offer after-hours or emergency service. Callback requests sent outside office hours are returned the next business day.

faqs.question: How soon can someone come?
faqs.answer: I can’t check the schedule or promise a time. Send a callback request and the office will contact you about the first available appointment.

faqs.question: Can I request a specific technician?
faqs.answer: You can mention it in your callback request, and the office will let you know whether that technician is available. I can’t assign technicians.

profile.emergencyMessage: Cedar Hollow doesn’t offer emergency service. Once emergency responders say it’s safe, you can call the office at (555) 010-0199 during office hours about repairs.
